'''Hollis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on [[Balmorra Orbital Station]] and directed incoming personnel to [[Farnel Outpost]] in [[Bugtown]].
